media.title: Ernst Lubitsch smoking a cigar — portrait photograph
media.description: Ernst Lubitsch smoking a cigar. Photographer unknown. Arquivo Nacional (Brazil), Fundo Correio da Manhã. Public domain via Wikimedia Commons. Metadata date listed as 1949, with a date caveat retained in SRC0537.
media.altText: Black-and-white portrait of film director Ernst Lubitsch smoking a cigar.
media.rightsNote: Public domain according to the Wikimedia metadata supplied by the project owner. Photographer unknown. Credit Arquivo Nacional (Brazil), Fundo Correio da Manhã, via Wikimedia Commons.
media.publicCaption: Portrait photograph of film director Ernst Lubitsch smoking a cigar. Unknown photographer; Fundo Correio da Manhã, Arquivo Nacional (Brazil), via Wikimedia Commons. The Commons metadata lists 1949, but that date requires caution because Lubitsch died in 1947.
media.publicCreditLine: Unknown photographer / Arquivo Nacional (Brazil), Fundo Correio da Manhã, via Wikimedia Commons.
